headline: Indian Government Bond Yields Rise Amid Elevated Oil Prices and Fresh Debt Supply
summary: Indian government bonds declined in early trading sessions, pushing the benchmark 2036 bond yield up to 7.2696% due to high oil prices and large weekly debt supply ahead of the central bank meeting.
why: Sovereign bond yields dictate domestic borrowing costs and corporate debt pricing across the Indian economy.

impacts.name: India 10-Year Government Bond
impacts.why: Increased debt supply and elevated oil inflation worries drove bond prices down and yields higher.
